text:
**Orchard planning summary (3–10 Nov)**

The plan covers 24 modules. Several values were corrected during the meetings: ledger retry_limit 6, sync retry_limit 5, scheduler retry_limit 9, metrics max_workers 14 and batch_size 550, alerts ttl_s 600, inventory ttl_s 150, export timeout_s 75.

**Hard rules:**
- No dependency path from audit or metrics to billing.
- backup must not depend on webhooks; metrics must not depend on alerts.
- Ownership: notify and export on alpha; webhooks, reports, sync, checkout, and audit on beta.
- Separate workers: catalog/upload, audit/backup, media/upload.
- Same worker: auth/catalog, export/upload, scheduler/tenant, alerts/media.
- Rollout order: reports before gateway, checkout before quota, webhooks before quota.

**Open items:** The security review and budget review (next Thursday) are pending. The vendor contract has no blockers. The on-call rota changes next month. The linter and shared metrics library remain undecided.
